results.content: When you read texts, whether scientific or non-scientific, it is important to evaluate the content and assess the quality of the source. It is also important to reflect on the purpose of the text, where and how you found it, the author's background, the quality and tone of the language used, etc. Scientific information is typically characterised by the fact that it is published in scientific publications by researchers within various subject areas. When working with scientific publications and other sources used in your studies, it is important to understand the differences between various types of publications and to know how to evaluate and assess the material you intend to use. :   Scientific journals in which scientific articles are published have clear guidelines concerning the type of research to be published and how submitted manuscripts are reviewed by experts. results.content: April 29, 2026 Call for Papers: Eastern European Holocaust Studies: Jewish Religious Life during the Holocaust. The editors of the journal Eastern European Holocaust Studies: Jewish Religious Life during the Holocaust invite submissions that examine Jewish religious life during the Holocaust and in its immediate aftermath. Contributions may explore how Jews sought to maintain, adapt to, or struggle with religious practice under Nazi persecution, including prayer and liturgy, the observance of Shabbat and Jewish holidays, life-cycle rituals (brit milah, marriage, and burial), rabbinic authority and leadership, clandestine worship, the smuggling of religious objects, theological and philosophical responses to suffering and divine absence, and the role of religion in the everyday life of refugees, as well as of Jewish men, women, and children in ghettos, camps, and in hiding. The European Association for Jewish Studies (EAJS) invites members of the EAJS and participants of the CEU conference ‘Jewish Studies at the Crossroads’ to join a Nahmanides-Forum on the impact of the events of and after 7 October 2023 on Jewish Studies taking place at the CEU Vienna June 3, 2026.
